name: Security service stopped
purpose: Detect when a security sensor or logging service is stopped on a host.
description: Matches stop events for a short, explicit list of security services (monitoring agent, antivirus, audit daemon, Sysmon).

attack.justification: Stopping a security tool is the observable action of Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools.

playbook.what: A security service was stopped on {host}.
playbook.why: A stopped sensor creates a blind spot. Attackers sometimes stop security tools before acting; so do routine upgrades.
playbook.howSure: Medium. Service stops are common during maintenance; the service name is what makes this notable.
next: Verify whether the service restarted and telemetry resumed.
Review other events on {host} just before and after the stop.
verify: The service is running again and events from {host} resume.
Coverage for {host} shows as observed (Assets page).
